To our beloved clients

By October 31st, 2024, We will no longer be accepting orders for leather straps, nameplates, and accessories. This decision is final as we shift our focus to a different career path. We want to sincerely thank all our clients and partners for their support over the past four years.


With good faith, please note that all pending orders will still be fulfilled and honored.

Thank you for your understanding.
